CreateMmsDataSource.description_en: Creates a data source to migrate data to MaxCompute using MaxCompute Migration Assist (MMA)
CreateMmsDataSource.description_zh: 创建数据源，通过MMA将数据源的数据迁移到MaxCompute

CreateMmsFetchMetadataJob.description_en: Creates a job to pull metadata from a data source
CreateMmsFetchMetadataJob.description_zh: “拉取数据源元数据”任务会将数据源的元数据拉取出来

CreateQuota.description_en: Creates a quota. When you activate MaxCompute for the first time, you must first create a pay-as-you-go quota. If you create a subscription quota, automatic payment is deducted
CreateQuota.description_zh: 创建Quota，首次开通MaxCompute 必须先创建后付费类型的Quota，如果创建的是预付费类型的Quota，会进行自动扣款

CreateRole.description_en: Creates a role at the MaxCompute project level

DeleteMmsDataSource.description_en: Deletes a MaxCompute Migration Assist (MMA) data source and its associated migration plans and metadata
DeleteMmsDataSource.description_zh: 删除MMA数据源，包括数据源的迁移计划、元数据

DeleteMmsJob.description_en: Deletes a MaxCompute Migration Assist (MMA) data migration plan

DeleteMmsTimer.description_en: Deletes a timer from a specified data source

DeleteProject.description_en: Deletes a MaxCompute project. This operation is irreversible. Use this API with caution
DeleteProject.description_zh: 删除MaxCompute项目。此操作不可逆，请谨慎调用此API

DeleteRole.description_en: Deletes a project-level role in MaxCompute

GetComputeEffectivePlan.description_zh: 获取当前生效的计算Quota计划

GetComputeQuotaPlan.description_en: Get detailed information of a single compute quota plan
GetComputeQuotaPlan.description_zh: 获取单个计算Quota计划的详细信息

GetComputeQuotaSchedule.description_en: Displays the time-specific configuration of compute quota

GetJobInfo.description_en: Queries basic information about a job
GetJobInfo.description_zh: 查看单个作业的基础信息

GetJobResourceUsage.description_en: Performs statistics on all jobs that are complete on a specified day and obtains the total resource usage of each job executor on a daily basis
GetJobResourceUsage.description_zh: 指定时间范围内，针对已结束的全部作业进行统计，以“天”为级别展示作业执行者级别的资源使用总量

GetMmsAsyncTask.description_en: Retrieves a single asynchronous task from MaxCompute Migration Assist (MMA)

GetMmsDataSource.description_en: Retrieves the details of a single MaxCompute Migration Assist (MMA) data source

GetMmsDb.description_en: Retrieves a database from a MaxCompute Migration Assist (MMA) data source
GetMmsDb.description_zh: 获取MMA数据源内的某个库

GetMmsFetchMetadataJob.description_en: Retrieves the details of a MaxCompute Migration Assist (MMA) job that fetches metadata
GetMmsFetchMetadataJob.description_zh: 获取单个MMA“获取元数据”任务详情

GetMmsJob.description_en: Retrieves the details of a single MaxCompute Migration Assist (MMA) migration plan
GetMmsJob.description_zh: 获取单个MMA迁移计划详情

GetMmsPartition.description_en: Retrieves a partition from a MaxCompute Migration Assist (MMA) data source
GetMmsPartition.description_zh: 获取MMA数据源内的某个分区

GetMmsTable.description_en: Retrieves a table from a MaxCompute Migration Assist (MMA) data source
GetMmsTable.description_zh: 获取MMA数据源内的某张表

GetMmsTask.description_en: Retrieves the details of a specific migration task
GetMmsTask.description_zh: 获取单个迁移任务详情

GetPackage.description_en: Obtains the information about a package

GetProject.description_en: Queries the basic information of a MaxCompute project

GetQuota.description_en: Retrieve information for the specified level-1 quota group. Warning: This operation will be decommissioned on July 31, 2024. It will be replaced by the `QueryQuota` operation. The request parameters, response parameters, and features of the two operations are the same
GetQuota.description_zh:
获取指定一级Quota组信息。
注意warning: 该接口会在2024年7月31日下线，我们会提供QueryQuota的接口替代，入参，出参，功能完全一样

GetQuotaPlan.description_en: Obtains the information of a quota plan

GetQuotaSchedule.description_en: Obtains the scheduling plan for a quota plan

GetRoleAcl.description_en: Obtains the ACL-based permissions that is granted to a project-level role
GetRoleAcl.description_zh: 获取项目级角色ACL授权信息

GetRoleAclOnObject.description_en: Obtains ACL-based permissions on an object that are granted to a project-level role
GetRoleAclOnObject.description_zh: 获取项目级角色对某对象的ACL授权信息

GetRolePolicy.description_en: Obtains the policy that is attached to a project-level role
GetRolePolicy.description_zh: 获取项目级角色Policy授权内容

GetRunningJobs.description_en: Obtains the running state data of jobs that are in the running state in a specified period of time
GetRunningJobs.description_zh: 指定时间范围内，所有仍处于“运行中”的作业的运行态数据展示

GetStorageAmountSummary.description_en: Retrieves a summary of the total storage amount

GetStorageSizeSummary.description_en: Retrieves a summary of storage usage

GetStorageSummaryCompared.description_en: Retrieves the year-on-year (YoY) change in storage usage
GetStorageSummaryCompared.description_zh: 获取存储趋势同比变化

GetTableInfo.description_en: Views the information about MaxCompute internal tables, views, external tables, clustered tables, or transactional tables
GetTableInfo.description_zh: 查看MaxCompute内部表、视图、外部表、聚簇表或Transactional表的信息

GetTrustedProjects.description_en: Obtains the trusted projects of the current project
GetTrustedProjects.description_zh: 获取当前项目的TrustedProject（受信任项目）列表

ListComputeMetricsByInstance.description_en: Lists the compute usage for jobs per instance
ListComputeMetricsByInstance.description_zh: 列出instance维度作业计算用量

ListComputeMetricsBySignature.description_en: View detailed compute usage for jobs by Signature
ListComputeMetricsBySignature.description_zh: 按Signature查看作业计算使用量明细

ListFunctions.description_en: Obtains functions in a MaxCompute project

ListInstances.description_en: Retrieves a list of projects for cost analysis over a specified time period
ListInstances.description_zh: 获取需要对某个时间段进行成本分析的实例列表

ListJobMetric.description_en: Queries a performance metric of the job that is complete
ListJobMetric.description_zh: 获取运行结束的作业的性能指标

ListJobSnapshotInfos.description_en: Retrieves job snapshot data at a specific point in time
ListJobSnapshotInfos.description_zh: 获取某个时间点的作业快照数据

ListMmsDataSourceConfigItems.description_en: Lists the configuration items for a specified data source type

ListMmsDbs.description_en: List databases in the MMA data source

ListMmsPartitions.description_en: Lists the partitions in a MaxCompute Migration Assist (MMA) data source

ListMmsTables.description_en: Lists the tables in a MaxCompute Migration Assist (MMA) data source

ListMmsTaskLogs.description_en: Lists the execution logs for a specific migration task
ListMmsTaskLogs.description_zh: 列出单个迁移任务的执行日志

ListMmsTasks.description_en: Retrieves a list of data migration tasks

ListMmsTimerLogs.description_en: Lists the logs of a scheduled task for a specific data source

ListMmsTimers.description_en: Lists the timers for a specified data source

ListPackages.description_en: Queries the packages in a MaxCompute project

ListProjectUsers.description_en: Queries a list of users in a project

ListProjects.description_en: Retrieves a list of MaxCompute projects

ListResources.description_en: Obtains resources in a MaxCompute project
ListResources.description_zh: 获取MaxCompute项目内的资源列表

ListStoragePartitionsInfo.description_en: Retrieves storage details for the partitions of a partitioned table in a MaxCompute project
ListStoragePartitionsInfo.description_zh: 获取某个MaxCompute项目内分区表的各分区存储明细

ListStorageProjectsInfo.description_en: Retrieves the storage details of projects

ListStorageTablesInfo.description_en: Queries the table storage details of a MaxCompute project
ListStorageTablesInfo.description_zh: 获取某个MaxCompute项目内的表存储明细

ListTables.description_en: Obtains tables in a MaxCompute project

ListTunnelQuotaTimer.description_en: Displays the time-specific configuration of an exclusive resource group for Tunnel (referred to as Tunnel quota)
ListTunnelQuotaTimer.description_zh: 查看数据传输服务独享资源组（Tunnel Quota）的分时扩缩容配置

ListUsers.description_en: Obtains users in a MaxCompute project
ListUsers.description_zh: 获取租户下的所有用户列表

ListUsersByRole.description_en: Obtains information about the users who are assigned a project-level role
ListUsersByRole.description_zh: 获取绑定某项目级角色的用户列表

QueryQuota.description_en: Queries the information about a specified level-1 quota group

QueryQuotaMetric.description_en: Queries the time series data of resource consumption for a quota
QueryQuotaMetric.description_zh: 查看quota资源消耗的时序信息

QueryStorageMetric.description_en: Queries time-series metrics of data storage
QueryStorageMetric.description_zh: 查看存储数据的时序指标

QueryTunnelMetric.description_en: Queries metric data for the Tunnel Data Transmission Service within a specified time range
QueryTunnelMetric.description_zh: 用于查询指定时间范围内的Tunnel数据传输服务相关指标数据

QueryTunnelMetricDetail.description_en: Queries details about the Tunnel Data Transmission Service for a specified time range
QueryTunnelMetricDetail.description_zh: 用于查询指定时间范围内的Tunnel数据传输服务相关详情数据

SumBills.description_en: Summarizes cost information by instance or billable item
SumBills.description_zh: 按实例或者计费项统计费用信息

SumBillsByDate.description_en: Retrieves a daily summary of costs, grouped by instance or billable item
SumBillsByDate.description_zh: 按实例或者费用项逐日统计费用

SumComputeMetricsByRecord.description_en: Calculates the total number of usage records

SumComputeMetricsByUsage.description_en: Aggregates compute usage by scanned data volume or CU usage
SumComputeMetricsByUsage.description_zh: 统计扫描量计算类的使用量或者CU时计算类使用量

SumDailyBillsByItem.description_en: View a daily breakdown of costs by instance or billable item
SumDailyBillsByItem.description_zh: 按实例或者费用项逐日统计费用明细

SumStorageMetricsByDate.description_en: Retrieves aggregated storage metrics over a specified date range, grouped by project or storage class
SumStorageMetricsByDate.description_zh: 指定日期查看各个类别的存储信息或各个project的存储信息

SumStorageMetricsByType.description_en: Aggregates storage usage by storage type
SumStorageMetricsByType.description_zh: 按存储类型统计存储使用量

TriggerMmsTimer.description_en: Triggers a timer for a specific datasource

UpdateComputeQuotaSchedule.description_en: Updates the time-based schedule for a computing quota

UpdateComputeSubQuota.description_en: Updates the basic configuration of a MaxCompute quota, including adding or deleting level-2 quotas, defining the basic attributes of a level-2 quota, and configuring compute units (CUs) for a quota plan that is in effect
UpdateComputeSubQuota.description_zh: 更新MaxCompute的基础配置，包括增加和删除二级Quota，定义二级Quota的基础属性和当前生效的Quota计划的CU配置

UpdateMmsDataSource.description_en: Refreshes the metadata of a MaxCompute Migration Assist (MMA) data source
UpdateMmsDataSource.description_zh: 重新拉取MMA数据源的元数据

UpdateMmsDb.description_en: Updates the metadata of a specified database

UpdateMmsTimer.description_en: Updates the settings of a scheduled task

UpdatePackage.description_en: Updates the objects in a package and projects in which the package can be installed
UpdatePackage.description_zh: 更新Package内的对象及允许安装的项目列表

UpdateProjectBasicMeta.description_en: Modifies the basic information of a project

UpdateProjectDefaultQuota.description_en: Updates the default computing quota of a project

UpdateProjectIpWhiteList.description_en: Modifies the IP address whitelist of a MaxCompute project

UpdateProjectModelTier.description_en: Upgrades a project's Layer 2 model to a Layer 3 model
UpdateProjectModelTier.description_zh: 将project的二层模型升级为三层模型

UpdateQuotaSchedule.description_en: Updates the scheduling plan for a quota plan

UpdateTunnelQuotaTimer.description_en: Updates the time-based auto-scaling configuration for an exclusive resource group for Data Transmission Service (Tunnel Quota)
UpdateTunnelQuotaTimer.description_zh: 更新数据传输服务独享资源组（Tunnel Quota）的分时扩缩容配置

UpdateUsersToRole.description_en: Adds or removes users from a project role
UpdateUsersToRole.description_zh: 项目角色添加或删除用户
